enrol.title: Set up this phone
enrol.intro: Enter your name so the kitchen can see who took the order.

error.codeUsed: Ask at the laptop for a new QR code. This code is no longer valid.
error.noConnection: Check that you are on the festival WiFi. This phone cannot reach the laptop.

enrol.orderHeld: The order you had started is still here. It comes back on the screen as soon as the phone is set up.

enrolCode.title: Set up with the six digit code
enrolCode.intro: Enter the six digit code shown on the laptop.
enrolCode.validity: The code is valid for five minutes and for one phone.

error.wrong: Read the six digits from the laptop again. This code is not correct.
error.retired: Ask at the laptop for a new QR code. This code was entered wrongly too often and is not accepted any more.

header.reconnecting: No connection to the laptop. The app keeps trying.
header.attention: {count} order needs checking. | {count} orders need checking.
header.stationPaperOut: The printer at {name} has no paper.
header.stationOffline: Station {name} is not answering right now.
header.stationFaulty: Tell the people at {name}. The printer there is not accepting anything any more.
header.stationWaiting: {count} slip is waiting there. | {count} slips are waiting there.

catalog.title: Take an order
catalog.paperWarning: Keep taking orders. The printer at {name} has no paper, and the slip prints as soon as somebody loads a roll.
catalog.offlineWarning: Keep taking orders. Station {name} is not answering right now, and the slip prints later.
catalog.itemSoldOut: Ask the guest whether they would like something else. {name} has just sold out.

line.whereHelp: The choice applies to this item only.

review.title: Check the order
review.tableHelp: Enter the table so the tray reaches the right table.
review.tableMissing: Enter a table before you send.
review.totalHelp: The amount is only an aid for adding up. You take the cash at the table as before.
review.totalChanged: Tell the guest the new total: {total}. The price was changed at the laptop a moment ago.
review.sendFailed: Tap "Send again". The laptop could not be reached, and the order is still here in full.
review.sendFailedDatabase: Tap "Send again". The laptop could not save the order just now, and the order is still here in full.
review.tooManyRequests: Wait a moment, then tap "Send again". The laptop is getting too many requests at once.
review.sendFailedAgain: Write the order on paper and take it to the station. Sending has failed several times.
review.duplicateRisk: Check your orders before you take this one again. It has already been sent.
review.conflictingChange: Somebody else changed something at the same moment. Try again.

orders.title: My orders
orders.empty: You have not taken an order yet today.

unknown.action: Check the pile at {station} for slip {sequence} and answer here.
unknown.reason: The connection to the printer broke while the slip was being sent, so nobody can tell from here whether it printed.
unknown.paperHint: The printer has also run out of paper.
unknown.answered: This question has already been answered.

ticket.paperEnd: Put a new paper roll into the printer at {station}. The slip prints by itself afterwards.
ticket.coverOpen: Close the cover on the printer at {station}. The slip prints by itself afterwards.
ticket.failed: Tell {station} about order {number} in person. The printer there is not answering.
ticket.failedAfterWaiting: Tell {station} about order {number} in person. The slip has been waiting there {minutes} minutes to print.
ticket.stationFaulty: Tell {station} about order {number} in person. The printer there is not accepting anything any more.
ticket.stationDisabled: Tell {station} about order {number} in person. The station is switched off at the laptop.
ticket.printerError: Fetch somebody who can look at the printer at {station}. The printer is reporting a fault.
ticket.testPrinter: Tell {station} about order {number} in person. The station is still on the test printer at the laptop, so there is no slip on the pile.
ticket.reprintQueued: The slip is printed again. It carries the same number again and is marked as a reprint.
ticket.handledOnPaper: The station has taken this order from the screen. No slip will be printed.
ticket.blocked: This slip is waiting because the station printer cannot print right now.
ticket.illegalTransition: This slip is no longer in the state you see on screen. Reload the page.
ticket.printJobAlreadyRunning: A print is already running for this slip. Wait for it before you print again.
ticket.printedOnTestPrinter: This slip printed on the test printer, so it is not at the station.
ticket.questionAlreadyAnswered: Somebody else has already answered this question.
ticket.reprintNotAllowed: This slip cannot be printed again right now. That is only possible once it has printed or failed.
ticket.resolvedByHuman: Somebody handled this slip by hand.
ticket.socketDropped: The connection to the printer broke. Whether the slip printed is still open.
ticket.timeout: The printer did not answer in time.
ticket.unknownOutcome: Whether this slip printed is still open. Check at the station.
ticket.unreachable: The station printer cannot be reached.

order.changedMind: Tell the station and take the change as a new order. A sent order cannot be taken back here, because its slip is already printing.
order.itemHasNoStation: One item on this order has no station set up. Tell whoever is at the laptop, and pass the order on in person until then.
order.notYours: This order belongs to another phone. You can only change your own orders.
order.quantityOutOfRange: That quantity is too large. Enter a smaller one or place two orders.
order.stationNotAssignedToItem: That station does not make this item. Choose another station.
order.stationRequired: Choose a station for this item.
order.submissionIdReused: This order was already sent with different contents. Check the order list before you send again.
order.tableLabelMissing: Enter a table before you send.
order.tableLabelTooLong: That table is too long. Write it shorter, for example: Table 12.
order.unknownItem: One item on this order no longer exists. Reload the menu and build the order again.

admin.notOnLaptop: Open the admin pages on the laptop itself at {url}.

overview.title: Overview
overview.ready: Everything is set up. You can now set up the phones.
overview.missingStation: Create at least one station, for example Kitchen and Bar.
overview.missingPrinter: Set up a printer for {name}. While the test printer is set there, no slip reaches the pile.
overview.missingItems: Create the items with their prices.
overview.itemsWithoutStation: Give {count} item a station. Without one it cannot be ordered. | Give {count} items a station. Without one they cannot be ordered.
overview.paperNearEnd: Put a new paper roll ready at {name}. The roll in the printer is running out.
overview.openTickets: Check the order list. {count} slip is still waiting to print. | Check the order list. {count} slips are still waiting to print.
overview.stationBlocked: Sort out the printer at {name}. {count} slip has been waiting there for {minutes} minutes. | Sort out the printer at {name}. {count} slips have been waiting there for {minutes} minutes.
overview.addressChanged: Set every phone up again. The laptop's address was {previous} and is now {current}.

stations.title: Stations
stations.help: A station is a kitchen or a bar with its own printer.
stations.openTickets: This station still has {count} open slip and cannot be switched off right now. | This station still has {count} open slips and cannot be switched off right now.
stations.lastForItems: Give {names} a different station first. This station is the only one for those items.
stations.deactivateBody: The station disappears from the list and takes no more orders. The orders placed so far stay saved. You can switch the station back on later.

items.title: Items
items.priceHelp: Prices are only there for adding up. No money is paid through the app.
items.needsStation: Tick at least one station. Without one this item cannot be ordered.
items.soldOutHelp: Switch an item to sold out as soon as it has run out. It stays on the phones and can no longer be chosen.
items.deactivateBlocked: Switch the item to "Sold out" instead. It cannot be taken off the menu while an event is running.
items.soldOutWalk: The laptop is the only place where you can switch this.
items.priceInvalid: Enter the price in euros, for example 3.50.
items.deactivateBody: The item disappears from the phones and can no longer be ordered. The orders placed so far stay saved. You can activate it again later.

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.help: Tick the stations where an item can be prepared.

tables.title: Tables
tables.help: These names appear as suggestions on the phone. A waiter can always type a different table.
tables.fromLastSession: Add the table names from the last event

printers.title: Printers
printers.hostHelp: Enter the printer's IP address, or search the network for it. Tapping a printer that was found also switches this station from the test printer to a network printer.
printers.searching: Searching. This takes about a minute.
printers.searchNone: Enter the address from the printer's self test. No printer was found.
printers.testPrintHelp: Print a test slip at every station before the guests arrive.
printers.faulty: Fault. Nothing more is being sent to this printer.
printers.reconnectHelp: Check the printer for a paper jam and a loose cable first. After that the printer accepts slips again.
printers.waiting: {count} slip is waiting for this printer. | {count} slips are waiting for this printer.
printers.shared: This address is also set at {names}. The slips for these stations come out of the same printer.
printers.sharedHelp: This is intended. When a printer fails, enter the address of a printer that is still working for that station.
printers.mockFolder: The slips from this test printer are in the folder {path}.
printers.mockFolderUnwritable: Announce the orders for {name} at the station in person. The test printer there cannot put slips anywhere, because nothing can be written into the folder {path}. Repair the setup afterwards, from the program window under Settings, or free up space on the hard disk.
printers.faultTitle: Simulate a fault on the test printer
printers.faultHelp: This shows what happens on the phone when a printer fails. The setting applies to the test printer only.

fault.dropEarly: The connection breaks before anything is sent
fault.dropMidJob: The connection breaks in the middle of printing
fault.unknown: The printer does not report whether it printed

staff.title: Waiters
staff.help: Set the phones up one after another. A waiter has exactly one phone.
staff.newCodeEffect: The phone {name} has been using can no longer send orders afterwards. With the new QR code {name} sets up a phone, a borrowed one as well.
staff.renameHelp: Change the name when a waiter mistyped it. From the next slip onwards the new name is on it.
staff.revokeConfirm: The phone belonging to {name} can no longer send orders afterwards. The orders {name} took stay saved.
staff.activate: Put the waiter back on the list
staff.deactivateTitle: Take this waiter off the list?
staff.deactivateBody: The name disappears from the list and the enrolled phone is signed out. The orders placed so far stay saved. You can put the waiter back on the list later.

enrol.title: Set up a phone
enrol.step1: The waiter scans this QR code with the camera on their phone.
enrol.step2: The waiter enters their name in the browser.
enrol.step3: The name is in the list afterwards.
enrol.validity: The QR code is valid for five minutes and for one phone.
enrol.cameraTitle: If the camera does not work
enrol.cameraStep: Open {url} in the browser on the phone and enter the code {code} there.
enrol.expired: Create a new QR code. This one was not scanned for five minutes.
enrol.codeRetired: Create a new QR code. The six digit code was entered wrongly too often and is not accepted any more.

orders.title: Orders
orders.unknownQuestion: Check the pile at {station} for slip {sequence} and answer here.
orders.noCancel: Tell the station. A sent order cannot be taken back, because its slip is already printing.

backup.title: Backup
backup.done: Copy the file {name} onto a USB stick. It holds the whole history and is in the folder {path}.
backup.openFolderHint: Open the folder from the program window, under Settings, with "Open the data folder".
backup.help: Create the backup file with this button. Copying the database file while the program is running can leave out the most recent orders.

diagnostics.title: Technical details
diagnostics.logHelp: This holds what the program did this evening. The file helps when a station received nothing.

admin.loadFailed: Reload the page. The data could not be loaded.
admin.itemsWouldHaveNoStation: Give {count} item a different station first, or take it off the menu. Otherwise it is left with no station and cannot be ordered. | Give {count} items a different station first, or take them off the menu. Otherwise they are left with no station and cannot be ordered.
admin.stationHasNoPrinterWorker: Try again in a moment. This station has no printer connection yet.

numbers.title: Slip numbers
numbers.help: The order number and each station’s slip numbers count up continuously. Reset them to 1 before a new festival.
numbers.confirm: Reset the slip numbers to 1 now? Orders already taken keep their numbers.
numbers.done: The slip numbers start at 1 again.

admin.itemNameMissing: Give the item a name before you save it.
admin.itemNeedsAStation: Tick at least one station so the item can be ordered.
admin.stationHasOpenTickets: This station still has open slips and cannot be switched off yet. Work through the slips and try again afterwards.
admin.stationNameMissing: Give the station a name before you save it.
admin.personHasNoPhone: No phone is enrolled for this person, so there is nothing to revoke.
admin.personNameMissing: Give the person a name before you save.
admin.stationIsNotOnTheTestPrinter: This station does not print to a folder. Practice faults are only available for stations that print to a folder.
admin.unknownMockFault: The program does not know this fault. Choose one from the list.
admin.unknownTransportKind: The program does not know this connection type. Choose one from the list.
admin.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again, and reload the page if it still does not work.
admin.itemHasNoActiveStation: Every station this item belongs to is switched off. Switch one of them back on, or assign the item to a station that is running.

station.title: {name}: orders on screen
station.warningTitle: This page is only for emergencies.
station.warningBody: Open it only when the printer has failed. In normal operation the station works off the pile of slips.
station.empty: There are no open orders. Every slip has printed.
station.filterHelp: Choose the station whose slips you want to see here.

status.cannotPrint: The printer cannot print right now

station.takeHelp: Write the table number on a piece of paper and put it with the food.
station.takeUnavailable: Fetch this slip at the printer. This station's printer is working.
station.takeRefused: Fetch the slip at the printer. This station's printer is printing again, so this slip was not taken.
station.takenPending: Tap "Undo" if you tapped the wrong row. This slip is taken in {seconds} seconds.
station.alreadyTaken: Somebody else has just taken this slip. Talk to each other so the order is made only once.
station.takenNote: No slip will be printed for this order any more.
station.alreadyPrinted: This slip has printed in the meantime and is on the pile.
station.printerBack: The printer is answering again. The slips are coming out of the printer again.

welcome.title: This phone is not set up yet.
welcome.body: Ask the person at the laptop to add you as a waiter. They tap "New waiter" there and show you the QR code, which you scan with your camera.

enrolment.oneCodeFormRequired: Scan the QR code or type the six digit code. Either one is enough.
enrolment.nameMissing: Enter your name so the kitchen knows who took the order.
enrolment.codeUnknown: The laptop does not know this code. Ask for a new code at the laptop.
enrolment.codeNoLongerValid: This code is no longer valid. Ask for a new code at the laptop.
enrolment.sixDigitCodeRetired: This code was typed in wrongly too often and is no longer valid. Ask for a new code at the laptop.

session.unsupportedLanguage: The program does not have that language. Choose German or English.
